title: Free Beauty Salon Revenue Loss Calculator: AI ROI
meta_description: Discover how much no-shows can cost your beauty salon. Use our free calculator to find out your potential losses and see the ROI of AI investment.
intro: Our Free Beauty Salon Revenue Loss Calculator helps you understand the financial impact of no-shows and last-minute cancellations on your business. This tool allows you to input your average appointment cost and frequency of no-shows to calculate the revenue lost due to missed appointments. With this information, you can evaluate the return on investment for implementing an AI-driven booking system to reduce cancellations and optimise your schedule.
cta: Save up to £3,000 per year with automated bookings. Book a demo today to see how Cold Lava AI can transform your salon's appointment management.
